title: A year ago I got the idea to combine my hobby with my favorite game
author: crackedpotstudio
selftext: A little over a year ago I got the idea to combine one of my favorite games (stardew valley) with my favorite hobby, growing bonsai. What started with me tinkering in Unity with the help of my work provided ChatGPT account slowly developed in a workflow with Godot,  Claude Code with 3 agents and Pixellab MCP hooked up. There is still a lot to work on and to improve on but the main gameplay loop is actually starting to look like something and I'm very proud to showcase my very first work in progress!
